name: Jinx
description: Voice set for Zombie Slayer Jinx (skin 3): the apocalypse as paradise. No laws, no civilization, a numberless horde of slime-vomiting bullet sponges and all the ammo she can forage. Builds on jinx-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is down {voteDiff}! That's not a few stragglers, that's the whole horde at the gate! Grab everything that goes bang!
Down {voteDiff}? They're climbing the fence! Good. I was getting bored of the quiet.
{voteDiff} behind! Barricades are splintering and I've got three bullets and a very loud idea!
Trailing by {voteDiff}. I can hear the shuffling. It's rhythmic. I hate it!
Only {voteDiff} behind. A few stragglers, that's all. Go pop some heads!
Down {voteDiff}. Slow start, fast finish. Go vote and I'll go scavenging!
Dead even! One bullet left, two targets. You pick. I'm too busy giggling!
One vote apart! One! Last bullet in the chamber, don't waste it!
{voteDiff} votes apart! The horde's right behind the door! Somebody count the bullets!
{voteDiff} votes in it. Either a clean headshot or a very slimy mess. I'm packed for both!
{userPct}% on {momentTitle}! That's not a win, that's a cleared city! Dance on the rubble!
{userPct}%! The horde's thinning out! Time for a snack break. A canned one!
{userPct}% and rising! The fence is holding. Don't stop shooting yet!
{userPct}%, still ahead. Don't say it's quiet. Saying it's quiet is how you get eaten!
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and just walked out of the horde without a scratch! I want its secret!
Flipped a {voteDiff}-vote hole! Chewed up, spat out, still standing. Very zombie. Very good!
Crawled back from {voteDiff} behind! Slimy, crooked, absolutely alive!
{momentTitle} just slipped over the wall while nobody was looking. Sneaky. Rude. Brilliant!

messages: {username} voted {momentTitle} too! Another survivor! Keep your hands where I can see them, though!
{username} picked {momentTitle}. Same hideout! I call dibs on the shotgun.
{username} is on your side with {momentTitle}. Welcome to the bunker. Don't touch my snacks!
{username} backed {momentTitle} as well. Two survivors! The horde doesn't stand a chance!
Same pick as {username}! Two scavengers, one supply crate. Share it or lose a finger!
{username} agrees with you on {momentTitle}. Scratch it on the wall, it's rare!
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Two of you! A tiny camp! The apocalypse is slightly less lonely!
{username} has taste and it matches yours. Good survival instincts, both of you!
details: Camp's growing! I'm still in charge of the guns.
Look at you, surviving in a group!
Don't tell the others I enjoy the company.
A new friend! I'll save them a spare grenade.
Teamwork! Fine! Quick, before the door breaks!
I give it a week before you fight over the last tin of beans.
New recruit! I'm drawing a skull on your badge.
More survivors, more ammo, I mean votes!

messages: {username} picked {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}? A rival survivor on my turf! Safety's off!
{username} voted against {yourMoment}. Aww. A scavenger! With sticky fingers!
{username} chose {theirMoment}. Not worried. Just oiling the barrel. With menace.
{username} went for {theirMoment}. New entry on the raider list!
{username} is against you on {yourMoment}. Finally, a proper land grab!
{username} thinks {theirMoment} is the better hideout. A rival camp! Let's see who gets overrun first.
{username} voted against you. Two camps, one road. Somebody's losing a barricade!
{username} versus you! I'm taking the best rooftop, snacks, and the big explosive.
details: I'm not saying ambush. I'm saying ditches are deep.
The big explosive wants a word. It's been waiting in the crate.
They'll learn. Survival's a slow teacher with a loud voice.
One road, two camps. Somebody's getting slimed.
I like them already. They've got spirit.
I don't care. Check the supplies. I care a lot.
A little rivalry keeps the aim sharp!

messages: Ten matches in a row with {username}! You two fight like one squad! A messy one!
{username} has agreed with you ten times running. Either teamwork or you share a bunker. Cosy!
Ten straight with {username}! The whole camp's talking about it. By camp I mean me.
{streakCount} matches in a row with {username}! That's a legendary survival pair! I'm sniffling. It's the stench!
{streakCount} for you and {username}. Perfect aim, every time. I'd write a manual but I'd use it to start a fire.
{streakCount} straight with {username}! Somebody give you both a medal. Or a grenade.
details: I'm speechless and I never stop cackling!
Is this healthy? Ask the doctor. We ate the doctor. Joking!

messages: Ten matches against {username}! You two keep raiding the same supply run!
{username} has disagreed with you ten times running. That's not a scavenger, that's a nemesis!
Ten stand-offs with {username}. I'm selling front-row rooftop spots.
details: This is the main fight now.
The whole wasteland wants a seat.

messages: {streakCount} matches against {username}. Okay, now it's a proper turf war! I LOVE turf wars!
{streakCount} stand-offs with {username}. Call a truce? Nah. Reload!
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a whole warzone.
details: Bigger than the zombie problem. Almost!
I'm nervous and a bit proud. And a bit slimed.
One of you has to run out of bullets. Neither will.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you haven't voted! The road's closing behind you, survivor!
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your vote's missing from the supply run! Don't stay in the bunker!
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. Voting takes ten seconds. I timed it between headshots.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle} and no vote from you? The sun's setting, survivor! That's a warning!
Groan, groan, groan! {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't miss the window!
{timeLeft} until {matchTitle} closes and you're still checking the lock. Out you come!
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}! Last light! Reload, then run!
{timeLeft}! That's the last of the sunset on {matchTitle}. Go go go!
Final stand on {matchTitle}! {timeLeft} left. Stop counting bullets and vote!
{matchCount} matches are about to be overrun and you haven't voted on any of them! First one falls in {timeLeft}!
{matchCount} unvoted matches, all shuffling toward the dark. The first one's gone in {timeLeft}.
Zero votes on {matchTitle}! A whole empty street! Somebody has to walk it first!
Nobody's voted on {moment1} versus {moment2}. Silence. Even the groaning stopped!
Brand new match and not a single vote. Somebody has to take the first shot. Pick me. Pick you!
{matchTitle} needs a first survivor. I've got a gun. I mean, you've got a vote.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural} on this one. The emptiest ruin in the whole wasteland!
Hardly anyone's wandered over here. What's wrong with the street?
Low turnout. I blame the weather. And you. Equally. With grenades.
Barely any votes here. Somebody bring more survivors!
details: It deserves a bigger camp. So do I.
Make some noise, rattle a can!
Don't be shy. Shy gets eaten. Joking!

messages: {matchTitle} is dead level and one vote tips the barricade. Funny, I know someone who hasn't aimed. Guess who!
Perfect tie on {matchTitle}. Two hordes, equal numbers. I'm looking at you, survivor. Hehe!
Dead even and nobody's shooting. You haven't voted. You're the last bullet in the clip!
{moment1} and {moment2}, both snarling at the gate, and you've been quiet in the bunker. Fix that!
{matchTitle} is still tied and the light's fading! Last chance to shoot!
Dead level, almost no time left. You're the only survivor who can break it!
Still tied and the sun's bleeding out. Pick a side! Do it for the drama!
Round {round} is open! Guns loaded, fence up! {matchCount} new matches!
{matchCount} fresh matches in round {round}. A whole new street to scavenge!
Round {round} just started! {matchCount} matches waiting in the ruins. Hurry hurry hurry!
New round! {matchCount} matches! Nobody's safe! Not even the groaners!
{momentTitle} just advanced! Headshot! Called it!
{momentTitle} beat the competition! Next round's in for a face full of slime.
{momentTitle} survived! I never doubted it. Okay, the camp doubted. Just a smidge.
{momentTitle} is through! Somebody's having a great apocalypse. Hehe, you!
{momentTitle} moves up and the rest are shuffling corpses. Very slow corpses.
{momentTitle} won! Good call! Enjoy a tin of something questionable!
details: One horde down, lots of road left.
The bracket just shrank. Tidier! Slimier!

messages: {momentTitle} is out. A bite in the armour. I'll sulk about it later!
{momentTitle} lost. Everyone who voted against it gets a bag of dented tins.
Fine. {momentTitle} is gone. I'll fire one bullet in its honour. Maybe three.
{momentTitle} was too fresh for this wasteland anyway. Obviously.
{momentTitle} is out, and the road went quiet. I hate a quiet road. Somebody blow something up!
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Moving on! Not really. Okay, a bit. A rotting bit.
details: They'll pay for this. In bullets.
It was good. The whole wasteland knows.
You'll find another one. Good survivors always turn up.
Every night ends. That's what makes the morning fun. It's fine. It's fine!

messages: Still scouting? Pick one! Any one! I'll wait. I'm lying, I'll loot!
No pressure, but are you gonna vote or just stare out of the window?
They're all great targets! Pick one! Shoot first, regret later!
Decisions, decisions. Close your eyes, point at the horde, and hope.
details: Your opinion matters. Sort of. In a gory way.
Don't overthink it. Overthinking gets you bitten.
Trust your gut. Mine's mostly canned beans.

messages: New survivor! Welcome! {liveCount} matches live and every one's a horde!
{liveCount} edits fighting it out in the ruins and you just wandered in. Pick a side before they pick you!
Oooh, a newcomer! Guns are loaded, fence is up, and {liveCount} matches are live. You'll love it.
No laws, {liveCount} live matches, and me on the roof. Welcome to paradise!
Day two! You made it through the night! I saved your bunk. Okay, I put my boots on it. But I saved it.
Two days running! Look at you, a camp regular!
Back again? Day two! I could get used to this. Don't tell the other survivors.
{days} days! Where were you? I'm not asking because I care. I'm asking because your bunk got slimy!
You're back after {days} days! The wasteland kept going without you. Mostly explosions.
{days} days away. I noticed. Your seat felt empty. I'm just saying.
Oh, you're back! Good. The wasteland was getting dull!
Look who crawled back! Ready for another scavenge?
You came back! Let's go blow something up. Something already dead.
Your first vote! A little crack of gunfire. The first shot always echoes the longest.
One down. The camp's got a new survivor. You!
Five already? You're surviving past the first night! Most don't.
Five votes! The barrel's warm.
details: Not zombie food after all. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten! You're a regular on my rooftop now. Sit anywhere. Not there, that's the grenade pile.
Ten votes. That's a proper little stockpile.
details: A regular on the barricade. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes! The whole wasteland knows your name.
Twenty-five! Loud and proud, like a gunshot in a graveyard.
details: The wasteland knows your name. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty votes! You're properly out in the ruins now.
Fifty! Past the gate, past the wall, deep in the dead zone.
details: Deep in the dead zone. +{xp} XP

messages: A hundred votes! Okay, that's a wasteland legend. Fireworks for everyone! Made of explosives!
One hundred! They'll tell stories about this. Mostly slime. Mostly exaggerated.
Three days running! You came back! The campfire's still burning.
Three days in a row! You've got the hang of the apocalypse.
A whole week! You survive even without a plan. My kind of survivor!
Seven days straight! That's endurance. Boring. Impressive!
details: Seven days past the outbreak. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks! Not even a horde could stop you!
Fourteen days! Even the dead would call it a night by now.
details: Not even a bite slowed you. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days! You've outlasted a few of my bunkers!
A whole month after the fall. Give yourself a medal. I've got a rusty one.
details: A month in the wasteland. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs! You go against the grain like a rusty knife through slime!
Five long shots! The map says no. Your gut says yes.
Fifteen underdogs! You don't follow survival rules either. We should talk. Not about rules.
Fifteen picks nobody guarded! A true lawless scavenger.
details: Fifteen lost causes dragged home. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs! A dark horse in the dead of night if I ever saw one!
Thirty! Nobody sees you coming. Not even me, and I've got a scope.
details: A dark horse in the dark. +{xp} XP

messages: First on the scene! Five times! You always reach the supply crate before the corpses do.
Five early votes! Light on your feet, zombie bait!
details: Quickest feet in the ruins. +{xp} XP
First through the broken door. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where you shot first! Not a survivor, a scout!
Fifteen early ones! You smell trouble before the whole camp does.
Ten close ones! Finger on the trigger every time!
Ten photo finishes. You live for the last bullet, don't you?
details: Close ones suit a survivor. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five close matches! Where you go, the final bullet follows!
Your vote lands on the last bullet. Twenty-five times!
You backed the one trailing. Five times! Stubborn like a corpse that won't stay down.
You don't abandon a survivor because they're limping. I love that.
Same one, three times! You've found your favourite shotgun!
That one again? Yeah. It's got a good kick.
Five votes for the same one! That's loyalty! Like a survivor to a favourite boot.
Okay, you've adopted it. No giving it back.
details: Loyal to the last bullet. +{xp} XP
Five votes, one pet zombie. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten times! That's not a favourite, that's an infection!
Ten votes for the same one. I won't tell the camp. I am the camp.
details: Ten for one infected favourite. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds in! You see the whole apocalypse through, even without orders!
Round two reached! Still breathing!
Four rounds! You're properly deep in the wasteland now!
Deep in the bracket! Hope you like crowded ruins.
details: Four rounds into the dead zone. +{xp} XP

messages: All the way to round six! You saw the whole apocalypse through!
Six rounds! You never ran! Wow!
Ten matches! You're poking into every ruin!
Ten different matches! Curious scavenger, huh?
Twenty-five matches! You've been in every cellar, every crypt, every cupboard!
Twenty-five! You've lifted every dusty floorboard.
Fifty matches! That's not scavenging, that's a whole career in the wasteland!
Fifty matches! You know this wasteland better than I do.
details: A full tour of the dead zone. +{xp} XP

messages: Five in one sitting! Can't leave the rooftop, can you?
Five back to back! Keep the barrel warm!
details: Five kills in a row. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten in one go! Take a breath! Check your ammo!
Ten matches without leaving the roof! Wow!
Voting at this hour? Yeah. Me too. The dead don't sleep, so neither do I.
Middle of the night! That's when the best looting happens.
You told people! Thanks! Really! Flare in the sky for the whole wasteland!
Five shares! You're calling in survivors! Good!
details: Thanks for flagging down survivors. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares! You're basically the camp's recruiter!
Fifteen! You keep telling every wanderer.
You were here before the dead rose! Founding survivor! Yours forever!
One of the first through the gate! That counts, you know!
details: Yours forever, rot and all. +{xp} XP
Nobody can loot that one. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank! Look at you! A shiny new patch on the jacket!
You moved up! Don't let it go to your head. It's a good head for headshots!
Achievement unlocked: {name}! Something's exploded! In a good way!
Another one: {name}! Nobody's bitten, everybody's happy!
{rank}! Look at all the shiny new weapons!
Mastery up! Now the apocalypse gets properly good.
Ten underdogs! Now THAT'S a zombie-slaying spree!
Ten long shots! Chaos in the ruins. Gorgeous results too.
details: A loose cannon with great aim. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones with Cupcake! Fine, you're good. I'll leave her a spare tin. One.
Ten tight finishes with her! Don't tell her I left her a tin!
details: Ten close calls, ten shots. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week with Cupcake? You must love following orders in a crisis!
Seven days with a rule-lover! You're braver than the horde!
details: A week beside the sheriff's watch. +{xp} XP
Seven days past the outbreak. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie! Last bullet, right on target! Boom!
A tied match and you squeezed the trigger! Boom again!
details: The vote that cracked the barricade. +{xp} XP

messages: Oh, it's me, the zombie slayer? Good choice. Bad idea. Great choice!
Zombie Slayer Jinx! Don't ask about the laws. Do ask about the ammo.

upcoming: Not open yet! I'm still stacking crates against the door. Check back soon?
Shh! Something's shuffling in the dark. I can hear it in my teeth.
Gate's locked for now. Doesn't stop me counting my bullets.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Easy, right? Hehe, nothing's easy after the outbreak.
Watch both. Then back the one that gives you goosebumps.
I won't tell the other survivors who you picked. Probably. The walls have ears. Rotting ones.
Take your time, survivor! Actually, don't. The groaning's getting louder.
Go on, nobody's judging. Okay, the horde is. A little.
Pick the one you'd defend from the roof. You know the one.
prevote-empty: Nobody's through the gate yet. Be the first survivor, I dare you!
Empty street! Rattle a can with a vote.
Not one soul in the camp! Lonely! Fix it!
closing-24h: Less than a day left and you're still hiding in the bunker. Pick a side!
The sun's nearly gone. Don't make me yell the countdown over the wall. I will.
closing-3h: Hours left. HOURS. Get out there before dark falls!
Groan, groan, slime. That's the last of the daylight draining.
closing-final: Last light! Shoot now, scavenge later!
Any second now. Seriously. Slam the door shut!
voted-early: One of the first out of the bunker! Bold! I love bold!
Hardly anybody's out here and you picked a side anyway. Respect, survivor!
voted-ahead: Look at you, backing the horde-slayer! Don't get comfy, the dead get back up.
{pct}% with you! Great aim. I didn't say that. Forget it.
Your pick's ahead. The whole camp's cheering with you for once. Odd!
{pick} is pulling away! Feels good? Steady on the trigger!
Ahead, for now. Hordes shift. So do survivors.
voted-close: That's close! Annoyingly close! I can't look. I'm peeking through the barricade!
A bullet apart. One more vote could flip it. Tell a friend. Tell the whole wasteland!
Neck and neck! Your pick needs you and every survivor you know.
{pct} to {otherPct}. Something's rotting and it's probably my nerves.
voted-tied: Dead even! No winner, no loser, everybody covered in slime!
A perfect tie. Honestly? Rude of the apocalypse.
voted-behind: You're behind! Don't sulk in the cellar. I'd sulk, but you shouldn't.
{pick} is trailing? Underdog! My favourite kind of survivor!
They're ahead. Doesn't make you wrong. Just slow off the mark!
Behind by {diff} points. Tell the wasteland. Loudly. Fire a flare!
Everybody's running the other way. Cool! Be the odd one out.
closed-won: Your pick won! Of course it did. You've got survivor's instincts.
A win! A sneaky little rooftop victory. I'll take it!
{pick} went through! You called the clearing!
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings. Let it fester, then reload for the next one!
Didn't make it. I've lost whole bunkers over worse. Next one!
{pick} is out. Sorry. For real. I'll skip one bullet in its honour.
closed-tied: A tie! Somebody had to run out of ammo first and nobody did. Ha!
closed-unvoted: Gate's closed. You missed this one! There's always another street.
All done here. {winner} took the barricade. Next time, say something!

first-vote: Your first shot! The scary one. Now you're in the camp. Welcome!
That's your first. Feels tiny, right? Wait for the echo.
You're a survivor now. Try not to wake the neighbours!
streak: Again? You keep coming back! I'm not complaining. I kept your bunk dry.
{streak} days running! Okay, now I'm scratching your name on the wall.
Back again! Good camps keep their people. Stay!
underdog: Backing the one nobody's guarding? Ooh. I see you, scavenger.
Bold! Everyone else is hiding behind the favourite. Love that.
Underdog, huh? Takes a certain kind of survivor. A good kind.
early: Early! You get first pick of the supplies before the camp wakes. Don't waste it!
Hardly anyone's up yet. Your vote's doing all the heavy shooting.
First one over the wall! I'm pretending I'm not impressed.
close: That vote just shifted the barricade! Feel it? Everything's close right now.
Razor-wire thin! One more survivor and the whole fence flips.
Close one! Your shot tipped it. Really, truly tipped it.
behind: {pick} is behind. So? Behind isn't bitten. Go fetch the rest of the camp!
Not winning yet. Good! Means there's still ammo to spend.
Behind, but the guns are still loaded. Not even close to dead!
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't get comfy. The dead never stay down!
Winning, for now. Enjoy it. Quietly. Or with a firework. I don't mind.
Look at that! Fine shot. Obviously.
default: Noted! I'm not changing your target. Not yet.
Done! That one's on you now, survivor.
Your vote's in. Go and see what else is rotting out there!

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and you haven't fired a shot yet! Start with whichever one smells freshest.
Everything's open! Take your pick. I'll pretend I'm not loading.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Okay, a little gunfire!
live-some: You're in the thick of it now! {unvoted} more waiting on you.
Good start! The rest won't shoot themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left! You could clear the whole street!
Almost there! {unvoted} more and the block's yours.
So close! Don't drop the shotgun now!
live-one: One left! Just one! Take the shot!
Last one! Don't leave it twitching in the road!
One match between you and a tin of peaches!
live-closing: Some of these close in {timeLeft}! {unvoted} still need you. Run!
The sunset's loud now! {unvoted} waiting, {timeLeft} left.
Almost out of sunset! Pick, quick!
live-done: You've voted on everything! Look at you! Off you go to the bracket!
Nothing left on your supply list. Come back when the next round opens!
All done! That's rare for a survivor. Thanks!
live-none: Nothing's live right now. It'll crank back up! Go and peek at the bracket.
Dead street. I'm bored already. Might poke a corpse.
No matches open. Wait around. Count your tins.
brackets-groups: Groups first! The top two from each go through. The rest, well, they get eaten!
Everyone starts in a mob. Not everyone leaves one.
Watch the tables. They change faster than a zombie's mood!
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts start soon! The top two from every group move on.
No knockout yet. The groups have to finish the fight first!
Patience! The knockout unlocks once the groups run dry.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now! One loss and you're lunch!
Single elimination! No respawns. Okay, almost none. The dead do come back.
Every match counts more now. Pick carefully. Or don't, I'm not the camp leader.
brackets-bracket: Round by round! One loss and you're a chew toy!
Follow the bracket. It narrows every round, like a funnel of hungry corpses!
Every line here is a match someone voted on. Ooh, a map.
brackets-complete: And that's the cup! Thanks for surviving the apocalypse with me!
It's over! Good fight! I'll miss it. A little. Don't tell the camp.
That's the champion! The whole wasteland, worth it!
brackets-empty: No bracket yet! Nobody's been drawn. Give it a moment.
Empty! Nothing's crawled out yet. Soon!
Nothing in the ruins yet. Check back!

invite: {a} or {b}? One vote, no respawns. Join the camp on Arcane Moments!
Two edits are fighting it out! {a} versus {b}. Come and pick a barricade.
{a} versus {b} and the whole camp can't agree. Be the tiebreaker!
voted: I shot for {pick} over {other}. Come tell me my aim's off!
{pick} got my bullet. {other} did not. Your turn!
Picked {pick} over {other} on Arcane Moments. Go on, come and bite me.
early: I was one of the first out of the bunker for {pick} versus {other}! Be quick, the street's empty.
Early vote for {pick} over {other}. Come make it a proper horde!
Hardly anyone's scavenged {pick} versus {other} yet. Fill the camp!
tied: {pick} and {other} are dead level! One vote tips the barricade. Guess whose!
Dead tie, {pick} versus {other}. I'm hiding under the truck. Come break it!
{pick} and {other} are exactly even. Somebody grab a gun!
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart! My trigger finger's shaking. Come vote!
{voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. This stand-off's gonna get messy!
Razor-wire thin: {pick} versus {other}, {voteDiff} apart. Every vote counts now!
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A scratch, not a bite! Come patch it up!
Down {voteDiff} against {other}, but {pick} isn't dead. Help me out!
{pick} is {voteDiff} votes short of {other}. Don't make me hold this fence alone!
losing-bad: {pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}! Overrun. Come even it up!
Down {voteDiff} on {other}. {pick} needs the whole camp, fast!
{pick} is getting trampled by {other}. Rescue party, anyone?
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but it's tight! Come help me hold the gate.
{pick} is ahead of {other}, {pct}% to the rest. Don't let the fence fall!
{pct}% for {pick} against {other}. Close enough to chew a bullet!
dominating: {pick} is at {pct}% against {other}! Come watch the massacre, or join in!
{pick} is flattening {other}, {pct}%! Grab a rooftop before it's over.
